entities.summary: eXeem was a peer-to-peer (P2P) file sharing client using the BitTorrent protocol. eXeem was designed to replace the need for centralized trackers. It largely failed to achieve this goal, and the project was canceled and eXeem's network was shut down by the end of 2005.
